name: Kyōtanabe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kyōtanabe city emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Kyōtanabe, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 June 1962.

features.role: Kyōtanabe city emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised swirl
